Lessons.Title: Different Ways to Solve Problems
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will represent and solve multi-step contextual problems involving multiplication and division, including division with remainders.
In this lesson, you analyze and use various strategies and representations to reason about multi-step problems. You use your knowledge of multiplication and division, including the ideas of factors and multiples, to represent situations.

Source activity sequence: Warm-up: Which One Doesn’t Belong: Expressions with 5 or 90 (10 minutes); Activity 1: Going on a Field Trip (20 minutes); Activity 2: A Trip to the Movies (15 minutes); Cool-down: Big Weekend at the Movies (5 minutes)
Exact mathematical focus: Multi-step word problems use equal groups and then compare the computed total with the budget.
Edulytics authored model: 45 tickets × $18 each = $810. The budget is $900. $900 − $810 = $90 left; the budget is sufficient.
First-party Cool-down: A class spends $17 per ticket for 28 tickets from $500. What remains?
Original diagrams, live construction, classroom response, and publisher login-gated Cool-down are not digitally certified.
